races.verdict: HMAS PERTH left his debut form behind when runner-up at Doncaster earlier this month, pulling clear of the rest, and he looks to hold leading claims of getting off the mark this time around. races.display_title: Qatar Racing And Equestrian Club Renaissance Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict: POWER BLUE has fallen short at Group 1 level this year but still looked a smart sort when scoring at this track in a Group 2 in July and this looks a good opportunity to add another success down in trip and grade. Big Gossey is so hard to rule out around here given his incredible course record and he'll run well, while Royal Bay Cen needs considering given how impressive she was fresh earlier in the season. POWER BLUE (IRE) BIG GOSSEY (IRE) ROYAL BAY CEN (IRE)
